reference_sql:
WITH placed AS (  -- one row per product, placed within its category by unit cost
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC) AS cost_place
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur, cost_place
FROM placed
WHERE cost_place <= 2

solver.query:
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur, cost_place
FROM (
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC) AS cost_place
  FROM products
  WHERE unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
) AS ranked
WHERE cost_place <= 2
